summary: HATI HOLDCO AS (org. no. 926 282 883) is a private limited company (AS) based in Brønnøy, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2020-12-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 50.102 (Innenriks kystruter med passasjerer); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was -NOK 628 000. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 8.96 bn. Board chair: Niels Smedegaard; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
